ValidationRule.description: Enforces that Running, Upload Pending, or Ready for Review states must have Worker Claimed At and all four frozen versions.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Running"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Upload_Pending"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Ready_for_Review")), OR(ISBLANK(Worker_Claimed_At__c), ISBLANK(Frozen_Posting_Revision__c), ISBLANK(Frozen_Profile_Version__c), ISBLANK(Frozen_Policy_Version__c), ISBLANK(Frozen_Template_Version__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Requests in Running, Upload Pending, or Ready for Review states must have Worker Claimed At and all four frozen input versions.
